reviews.author: Clarke Bates
reviews.text: Kyle was awesome and took care of my favorite vehicle my 2008 Nissan Armada that wouldn’t start. Reliable, trustworthy, and honest. My new go to for vehicle repairs. Can’t say enough good things about Kyle, the mechanic. Thank you!!

reviews.author: LotaHOPE Admin
reviews.text: There are still good people and a good company in this world. We were delivering a cabin on a flatbed truck and ended up get stuck in the mud. We called Eastover and Kyle (the driver) wife answered with a welcoming voice and assisted me with getting in touch with Kyle. She told me everything I needed to do and Kyle would reach out to me. I took pictures and sent him a pin drop of the location. Sure enough, Kyle called and gave me an estimate with a great attitude. He said he could be there in 35 minutes. The biggest part was when Kyle got there he assisted the forklift driver with getting the forklift out the mud with patience and skills. That was a huge help for the owner of the cabin that was being delivered. If Kyle hadn’t done that we would’ve strapped the wood back down and left. Kyle then stayed to make sure we were able to back out safely onto the main street. Lord, I pray that you be with Kyle and his entire family. I pray that you keep him humble and honest. I Pray that you keep him safe as he continues to work everyday on the dangerous highways and bi ways. I pray that the business in increase more abundantly some 30, 60, and some 100 fold in the name of Jesus. So that more people can experience that there are still good people in this world. LOTAHOPE!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Jackson
reviews.text: This place went above and beyond for my daughter. Her husband had deployed, she had no family or friends in the area. Kyle made sure everyone knew to try to get to her first thing in the morning. They came over first thing this morning, very friendly and respectful. They diagnosed truck, took back to shop, fixed it quickly and delivered it back to her. Everyone we talked to and dealt with there went above and beyond. I cannot recommend them highly enough. The BEST experience we’ve had with anyone in this state. This service is very rare this day and age. Sad but true! Thank you again for going the extra mile for my daughter!! Do not hesitate to call this company for any service. Michelle

reviews.author: Carl Jenkins
reviews.text: My semi broke down on the side of the road. Not only did Kyle accept the truck and trailer on a Saturday at his location but he had it diagnosed first thing Monday morning. The worst of my fears were confirmed the clutch and input shaft were bad. Kyle came to the rescue and had this large job done within 2 days. Now came time to pay, and I thought it was going to be a substantial bill. To my surprise it has been the most reasonable price I've ever received from a mechanic for a job that big. Eastover service has earned a customer for life. I, 20 out of 10 recommend kyle and his team of pros!!

reviews.author: Anthony L
reviews.text: Called Kyle at 4 pm Saturday Labor Day weekend. Only guy willing to come take a look at the issue one of my trucks was having in Chesapeake Virginia. Wheel bearing went bad and needed to be fixed ASAP. Humble and honest is just the start of this guy. He came out looked at it scrambled till 1 am that night locating parts, no other company was willing or wanted to be bothered but he got it done. Fair priced and just an all around nice guy. His follow up, was spot on every time he said he would call back or be there. Hands down would not hesitate to call him if I was in the area with an issue. Thanks again Kyle.

reviews.author: David Trucker
reviews.text: Had an air leak couldn’t find where the heck it was and lucky enough Eastover Service was right across the street from the drop location. Made me park on the street since I had 53’ trailer attached, had to wait a bit since they were very busy (good shops are always busy) then when it was my turn it took them 15 mins to take care of the issue. One of those few shops that’s left with good people thanks!!!

reviews.author: Julie Vinson
reviews.text: My husband and I were in an accident on a dark, back country road, in a curve. We called several companies and Eastover was the only one who did not blink an eye. Kyle arrived approximately 20 minutes after we called. He was very professional and took his time with us as we were upset. He got us and our truck home safely!!!!! Thank you Kyle & Eastover!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Bernard Dietsch
reviews.text: An upfront, honest, and reliable source for good mechanical services. Corrected my check engine light on my gas motorhome quickly at a fair price!

reviews.author: Daniel Roman
reviews.text: Went in for a state inspection. Got an estimate to replace brakes. Prices are fair. The owner is humble and honest. I'll be coming back here for my future car repairs.

reviews.author: Nathan Neblett
reviews.text: Reasonable price. Honest diagnosis and gave me options. Had my vehicle done sooner than I expected. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Peabody
reviews.text: Provided quick diagnoses, ordered a part locally, and installed! We resumed our trip about 75 minutes later. Outstanding!

reviews.author: jason wager
reviews.text: Definitely saved the day and good people to work with. Got my lowboy back on road despite difficulties. Highly recommend

reviews.author: It’s A Wonderful Life
reviews.text: God has really endorsed me to meet this family last night. They towed my car and will get it fixed! Thank you, Kyle and Kristin!

reviews.author: Becky Knight
reviews.text: We were down a company truck, and Eastover was able to get us up and running quickly! Definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Beverly Judkins
reviews.text: Have taken my RV and car and truck for general maintenance and repair. Reasonably priced.Wayne Wiggins is fair, friendly, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Donna Silver
reviews.text: Kyle was very efficient and friendly when I had my state inspection today! I highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Matthew Stoudenmire
reviews.text: Phenomenal experience with Kyle. I’d go out of my way to have him service my equipment. Fantastic staff!

reviews.author: Scott Cornette
reviews.text: They provided very quick and thorough service. I would highly recommend them for vehicle repairs and state inspections.
